propositions: DC lacks two convergence test suites that are critical to prevent re-emission of truncated comment and description text across multiple sync passes

DC's comment and description sanitization both bind to WIKI_DESCRIPTION_LIMIT (32767) and fit_outbound, but the binding lacks provenance documentation citing jira.text.field.character.limit and JRASERVER-28519 as the authoritative source

DC convergence tests driven through compute_outbound_mutations may silently resolve to Cloud's backend if outbound_mapper, inbound_mapper, or links are omitted, causing tests to pass while actually validating Cloud behavior, not DC

DC comment convergence cannot be validated by value-based assertions alone because DC and Cloud truncate comments identically at 32767 chars with identical suffix markers, requiring identity or recording checks instead

Oversized DC descriptions and comments must converge to zero-mutation plans on pass 2 to prevent recurring truncation re-sends, and current absence of DC-specific convergence tests creates risk of silent data loss cycles
